change_guide: To change opening hours or prices, edit config.json and restart the service. To change the handoff rule, edit the escalation list in the same file and run the test suite before going live.
deliverables: Enquiry response service connected to the booking calendar
Handoff rule for clinical questions, routed to a human
Follow up sequence for enquiries that go quiet
next_problem: No shows after booking. The follow up data from this build names it plainly, and a reminder sequence is the natural next engagement.
run_instructions: Start the service with the command in the runbook, check the health endpoint, and confirm the test enquiry receives a reply within one minute.
support_terms: 30 day support window from delivery for defects in the delivered scope. Changes, new channels, and new locations are new scope. Replies within one business day.
